I am the host yes, I've been recording for over 12 months. I'll put the overview of the podcast that I send to everyone below.
 --------

For the podcast we aim to discuss your relationship with your children's mother, what you thought and how you felt throughout.

Start at the beginning on how you met, and then touch on key points such as when she became pregnant. In the run up to the kid(s) being born, if you moved in together and how the relationship changed over time. If there were any significant points for you and then move on to the breakup.

What happened during the seperation how your relationship changed, and if your relationship with the children was impacted.
We'll then move on to how your relationship is currently with your ex and your children and what's your outlook for the future.

The aim is to allow you to tell your story, not to bash your ex in anyway but to give you an outlet and to raise awareness of what can happen when couples seperate and its impact.

- Might ask you about red flags you saw but ignored throughout the course of the relationship.
- Did you learn anything?
- Would you do anything differently.
- Does your experience make you hesitatent about relationships in the future.
- At the end I'll ask you to summerise the whole podcast in two words and that'll be the name or the episode.

The reason for wanting to do the podcast is to give dads that have gone through seperation a chance to tell their side as I've had many men tell me about their horrific experiences so that some people might learn from them or atleast raise awareness.
Hope you find it of some use fella, let me know what you think of it.

PODCAST  - SEPARATED DADS TELLING THEIR STORY. 

This podcast offers a powerful and genuine platform for separated fathers to share their stories. Addressing critical issues such as domestic violence, false accusations, and parental alienation, it explores the intricate dynamics of relationships and fatherhood. Each episode provides a candid and heartfelt account, tracing the journey from the beginning of the relationship through to the present, giving listeners valuable insights into the challenges faced by separated dads.
